findings.title: How close Locksmith gets to the final margin
findings.text: Locksmith misses the final margin by 12.57 points on average; the closing spread misses by 12.25, the opening spread by 12.32 (Locksmith on the same games: 12.52).

findings.title: Does the market move toward Locksmith?
findings.text: When Locksmith disagreed with the opener by 3+ points, the line moved its way before kickoff 55% of the time (correlation 0.26, 8,325 games). That is the sign of real information the opener had not priced yet.

findings.title: Spread at the opening line (cover model)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 42-54 (-16.3%, -15.8 units). The same bets at the closing line: -16.2%. They beat the closing number 40% of the time.

findings.title: Total at the opening line (cover model)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 2021-1658 (+4.8%, +179.3 units). The same bets at the closing line: +1.5%. They beat the closing number 53% of the time.

findings.title: Spread at the opening line (raw gap)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 951-798 (+3.7%, +66.5 units). The same bets at the closing line: -1.2%. They beat the closing number 57% of the time.

findings.title: Total at the opening line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 2152-1799 (+3.9%, +157.4 units). The same bets at the closing line: +0.8%. They beat the closing number 49% of the time.

findings.title: Windy-game unders at the opener
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 707-569 (+5.7%, +73.7 units). The same bets at the closing line: +0.2%. They beat the closing number 61% of the time.

findings.title: Spread at the closing line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 402-407 (-5.0%, -41.5 units).

findings.title: Total at the closing line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 165-175 (-7.3%, -25.0 units).

findings.title: Windy-game unders at the close
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 444-390 (+1.6%, +13.6 units).
